batch: 2026-11-15 网上卖家（俊宇：找 15 个做 Shopee / 网上电商的商家，可以打电话 + WhatsApp）
source: 查了 Shopee 新闻稿里的卖家、Linktree、kek lapis 网上卖家名单（MalaysiaNow / SAYS 2021）、RHB Jom Sapot 商家名单。每家跑过 check-domains.sh；有自己网店的（The Skin Lovers、Paulini、Chixxie、Rasa Suri、Layer Cake by Aviante）没有放。Shopee 店确定的只有 3 家，其他是 IG / WhatsApp / Grab 上卖的网上卖家；2021 年的号码在 verify 里写明要先确认。

leads.name: Anika Ginger Tea
leads.contact_source: linktr.ee/anikagingertea 上的 WhatsApp 按钮（2026-11-15 看过）
leads.why: 自己的姜茶品牌（红枣、柠檬、香茅姜茶），Shopee 和 Lazada 都有店，没有自己的网站；产品 RM18–35。
leads.verify: 号码来自 Linktree；打电话时问是在哪里做的、Shopee 一个月大概多少单；没有报道，所以是 B 级。
leads.input:
What they sell: Anika Ginger Tea, own-brand native ginger tea and botanical drinks: ginger, red dates ginger, lemon, lemongrass ginger sachets (15g x 8, RM18) and traditional ginger tea bottles (200g/300g, RM35).
Channels: Shopee (seller id 289307057) and Lazada (anika-ginger-tea-entreprise), WhatsApp 60124445595 on their Linktree. No own website.
Website check (2026-11-15): check-domains.sh anikagingertea anikaginger -> NONE. No own online store found in the source.
Angle: they already sell on two marketplaces; an own shop lets repeat buyers reorder without platform fees and lets them sell bundles / gift boxes for festive seasons.
Sources: linktr.ee/anikagingertea (checked 2026-11-15).

leads.name: Intan Kek Lapis Sarawak

leads.verify: 资料是 2021 年的：先看 Shopee 店还有没有在卖；节日（农历新年、Raya）是旺季，问他们节日订单怎么接。
leads.input:
What they sell: Kek lapis Sarawak (layer cakes) in many flavours, RM14.40-29.70 (2021 list). Based in Sarawak, delivers throughout Malaysia.
Channels: Shopee shop 336551591, Instagram @intan_keklapis, phone/WhatsApp +6017-3503450.
Signals: Listed in a 2021 roundup of Malaysian kek lapis sellers.
Website check (2026-11-15): check-domains.sh intankeklapis intankeklapissarawak -> NONE. No own online store found in the source.
Angle: kek lapis is a festive gift (CNY, Raya, Christmas); an own pre-order page with gift boxes and corporate orders, alongside Shopee.
Sources: MalaysiaNow 2021-07-01 "10 Malaysian small businesses selling traditional home-baked kek lapis online" (same list as SAYS).

leads.name: Hai Seng Hin 海成兴（Pangkor 鱼沙爹）
leads.contact_source: RHB Jom Sapot 商家名单（WhatsApp 和电话）；旅游网站写工厂电话 05-688 2333
leads.address: Kilang Satay Ikan Hai Seng Hin, Sungai Pinang Kecil, 32300 Pangkor, Perak
leads.why: 1969 年开始的 Pangkor 鱼沙爹、墨鱼丝、虾饼工厂（两间工厂、两间门市），游客常去；GrabFood 上有他们的产品，但没有自己的网站可以全马下单。
leads.verify: 号码来自 RHB 名单（2020–21）和旅游网站：先打座机；问游客回去后怎么回购（现在是不是只能来 Pangkor 或找经销商）。
leads.input:
What they sell: Satay fish (ikan satay), satay cuttlefish, sotong pedas, prawn crackers, dried and frozen seafood. Established 1969; two factories (Pangkor Island and Sri Manjung) and two outlets; halal certified; factory at Sungai Pinang Kecil, Pangkor is a tourist stop where visitors watch production.
Channels: WhatsApp +60125056263 and phone 05-688 1111 (RHB directory), factory 05-688 2333 (travel guide), Facebook facebook.com/hsh.ent. Their sotong products appear on GrabFood via resellers.
Website check (2026-11-15): check-domains.sh haisenghin haisenghinpangkor hsh -> NONE (hsh.com.my is a different company). No own online store found in the source.
Budget signal: 55+ years, two factories, export trade.
Angle: tourists who bought in Pangkor can reorder online nationwide; gift boxes for CNY / Raya; wholesale enquiry form.
Sources: RHB Jom Sapot business directory (rhbgroup.com/jomsapot, list of businesses with their own WhatsApp numbers, 2020-2021); Penang Travel Tips (Kilang Satay Ikan Hai Seng Hin); Tridge supplier profile.
